content.rationale: rxqsupwm decides which files the repository tracks and which it leaves out; vqultolm is the record that separates the extension's authored runtime files (media/webview.html, the src/styles/*.css the page names) from what is built from sources (out/, src/webview/main.js), vendored (node_modules, the codicon stylesheet and font among them) and packaged as a .vsix. The check projects that split onto the repository and asks git's own matcher about representative paths of each class in both directions: every generated or vendored path must be ignored, and no authored runtime source may be, so the ignore set neither leaks a build product or package into the repository nor drops a file the installed extension needs. It reads the effect of the rules rather than their spelling, order or count, so any rule set that draws the packaged set's line passes, while a looser one (a generated class still tracked) or a stricter one (a runtime source untracked) fails naming the offending path. vqultolm is natural-layer prose and the artifact is tool-checkable, so this edge is the matrix's natural-to-code cell and takes the fidelity form.
